brief: 6 mindset shifts that changed everything for me at 30.

slots.title: SIX SHIFTS THAT CHANGED EVERYTHING AT THIRTY
PROGRESS BEATS PERFECTION
slots.body: I used to wait until everything was flawless before shipping any work. Now I ship fast, iterate faster, and let real feedback guide me. Perfection was just fear wearing a disguise.

slots.title: REST IS NOT LAZY
slots.body: Burnout isn't a badge of honor; it's a warning sign. I started scheduling recovery like I schedule meetings, and my creativity doubled overnight. You can't pour from an empty cup.

slots.title: NO IS A SENTENCE
slots.body: People-pleasing left me exhausted and resentful. Setting clear boundaries freed up my time and earned me more respect than saying yes ever did. Protect your peace fiercely.

slots.title: FAILURE IS JUST DATA
slots.body: I stopped treating mistakes as personal disasters. Every misstep became a dataset for better decisions. Reframe failure as tuition for the life you actually want.

slots.title: INVEST IN YOURSELF FIRST
slots.body: I used to save whatever was left after spending. Flipping that script changed my financial future. Pay your future self first, then live on what remains.

slots.title: SKILLS PAY THE BILLS
slots.body: Job titles are temporary; abilities are permanent. I shifted focus from chasing promotions to building rare and valuable skills. Income follows leverage, not loyalty.

slots.headline: PICK ONE AND START TODAY
slots.body: Don't wait until thirty to figure this out. Choose one shift and practice it this week.
